title: Chilean temporary residence for nationals of the Mercosur Residence Agreement states (Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay)

Ley N.º 21.325, article 74: dependents of a temporary resident, and the principal's proof of economic activity or stable income enough for their upkeep
Decreto N.º 177/2022 (temporary residence subcategories), in force 2022-05-14, article 46: a treaty permit has the requirements and effects the applicable treaty sets
Decreto N.º 177/2022, articles 72 to 74: permits for dependents, their documents, and the principal's means measured against the Social Development Ministry's indicators

Servicio Nacional de Migraciones: dependents of a temporary resident, their documents, and the principal's means measured against the Social Development Ministry's indicators

requirements.title: National by origin of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay or Uruguay, or naturalized there for five years or more

assessments.title: When family members apply as dependents, the principal shows enough economic resources for their upkeep, by the indicators of the Social Development and Family Ministry
Adults show a criminal record certificate from the country of origin or of residence in the last five years, issued no more than 60 days before
